Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Edit films and videotapes to insert music, dialogue, and sound effects, to arrange films into sequences, and to correct errors, using editing equipment.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Select and combine the most effective shots of each scene to form a logical and smoothly running story.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Review footage sequence by sequence to become familiar with it before assembling it into a final product.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Set up and operate computer editing systems, electronic titling systems, video switching equipment, and digital video effects units to produce a final product.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Trim film segments to specified lengths and reassemble segments in sequences that present stories with maximum effect.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Cut shot sequences to different angles at specific points in scenes, making each individual cut as fluid and seamless as possible.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Review assembled films or edited videotapes on screens or monitors to determine if corrections are necessary.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Verify key numbers and time codes on materials.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Manipulate plot, score, sound, and graphics to make the parts into a continuous whole, working closely with people in audio, visual, music, optical, or special effects departments.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Program computerized graphic effects.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Study scripts to become familiar with production concepts and requirements.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Supervise and coordinate activities of workers engaged in film editing, assembling, and recording activities.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Determine the specific audio and visual effects and music necessary to complete films.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Mark frames where a particular shot or piece of sound is to begin or end.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Record needed sounds or obtain them from sound effects libraries.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Conduct film screenings for directors and members of production staffs.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Discuss the sound requirements of pictures with sound effects editors.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Piece sounds together to develop film soundtracks.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Confer with producers and directors concerning layout or editing approaches needed to increase dramatic or entertainment value of productions.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Develop post-production models for films.

Title: Film and Video Editors
Task: Collaborate with music editors to select appropriate passages of music and develop production scores.
